llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及通过选择性激光熔化加工锆基非晶合金，但未涉及生物医学植入物设计或力学性能测试。
llm.why_not_core: No implant design, no biomedical testing, no stress shielding or stiffness matching analysis, no osseointegration evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究Zr基非晶合金在SLM工艺中的成形能力。
summary_zh.method: 采用选择性激光熔化制备Zr基非晶合金试样。
summary_zh.result: 成功制备出高致密度非晶合金，分析了工艺参数对成形的影响。
summary_zh.validation: 通过XRD、DSC和密度测量验证非晶特性。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the processability of a Zr-based bulk metallic glass via selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Zr-based alloy powder was processed by selective laser melting (SLM) under varying parameters.
summary_en.result: Dense amorphous parts were obtained, and the influence of processing parameters on glass formation was characterized.
summary_en.validation: Amorphous structure was confirmed by XRD and DSC, and density was measured to assess quality.

llm.why_not_core: This paper uses aluminum (not biomedical metals), no porous structure, no stress shielding analysis, no fatigue testing, no surface roughness or osseointegration considerations.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究扫描策略和熔池形态对SLM铝合金微观组织和拉伸性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 采用不同扫描策略制备铝合金试样，进行微观表征和拉伸测试
summary_zh.result: 优化扫描策略可获得细小等轴晶和改善的拉伸强度与延伸率
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸实验验证力学性能，结合金相与SEM分析微观机制

summary_en.motivation: To understand how scan strategy and molten pool geometry affect the microstructure and mechanical properties of SLM-processed aluminum alloys.
summary_en.method: Aluminum samples were fabricated by selective laser melting with varying scan strategies, followed by microstructural characterization and tensile testing.
summary_en.result: Optimized scan strategies led to finer equiaxed grains and improved tensile strength and elongation.
summary_en.validation: Tensile tests were performed to validate mechanical properties, supported by metallographic and SEM analysis of microstructures.

papers.title: Double printing of hyaluronic acid/poly(glycidol) hybrid hydrogels with poly( ε -caprolactone) for MSC chondrogenesis
papers.abstract: This study investigates the use of allyl-functionalized poly(glycidol)s (P(AGE-co-G)) as a cytocompatible cross-linker for thiol-functionalized hyaluronic acid (HA-SH) and the optimization of this hybrid hydrogel as bioink for 3D bioprinting. The chemical cross-linking of gels with 10 wt.% overall polymer concentration was achieved by a UV-induced radical thiol-ene coupling between the thiol and allyl groups. The addition of unmodified high molecular weight HA (1.36 MDa) enabled the rheology to be tuned for extrusion-based bioprinting. The incorporation of additional HA resulted in hydrogels with a lower Young's modulus and a higher swelling ratio, especially in the first 24 h, but a comparable equilibrium swelling for all gels after 24 h. Embedding of human and equine mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) in the gels and subsequent in vitro culture showed promising chondrogenic differentiation after 21 d for cells from both origins. Moreover, cells could be printed with these gels, and embedded hMSCs showed good cell survival for at least 21 d in culture. To achieve mechanically stable and robust constructs for the envisioned application in articular cartilage, the formulations were adjusted for double printing with thermoplastic poly(ε-caprolactone) (PCL).

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及生物墨水和细胞分化，但完全没有AI或机器学习在生物打印中的应用。
llm.why_not_core: No AI/ML integration in any bioprinting workflow stage, no autonomous decision-making, and no computational modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发用于软骨再生的可打印杂化水凝胶生物墨水。
summary_zh.method: 利用紫外光引发硫醇-烯偶联交联HA-SH和P(AGE-co-G)，调节流变性并进行双打印。
summary_zh.result: 水凝胶支持MSC软骨分化，与PCL双打印获得机械稳定结构。
summary_zh.validation: 体外培养MSC 21天，评估细胞活力和软骨分化。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a printable hybrid hydrogel bioink for cartilage regeneration using thiol-ene crosslinking.
summary_en.method: UV-induced radical thiol-ene coupling between thiol-functionalized hyaluronic acid and allyl-functionalized poly(glycidol) was used, with rheology tuning via high molecular weight HA and double printing with PCL.
summary_en.result: The hydrogels supported chondrogenic differentiation of MSCs and double printing with PCL provided mechanical robustness.
summary_en.validation: In vitro culture of human and equine MSCs for 21 days with assessment of cell viability and chondrogenic differentiation.

papers.title: Implementation of a stratified approach and gene immobilization to enhance the osseointegration of a silk-based ligament graft.
papers.abstract: A silk scaffold exhibits high potential for the human anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) reconstruction due to its exceptional mechanics as well as biocompatibility. Inefficient ACL interface restoration is thought to be a major hurdle for the common implementation of a silk-based ligament graft. By integrating a stratified approach and gene immobilization, here we developed a gene-immobilized triphasic silk scaffold to enhance ACL osseointegration. Isotropic silk was divided into three regions (respectively corresponding to a ligament, fibrocartilage and the bone region of the native ACL interface) using a custom-made divider, and the lentiviral vector-encoded transforming growth factor beta-3 (TGF-β3) and bone morphogenetic protein-2 (BMP2) was further, respectively, immobilized to phosphatidylserine (PS)-coated fibrocartilage and the bone region of the triphasic silk scaffold. The in vitro assessments displayed that this gene-immobilized triphasic silk scaffold significantly promotes bone marrow mesenchymal stem cell (BMSC) proliferation and differentiation into corresponding cell lineage. Moreover, the gene-modified triphasic silk scaffold combined with BMSCs alone, which was rolled into a compact shaft to be implanted onto rabbit ACL-defect models, revealed roughly complete osseointegration restoration as a result of apparent three-layered tissue formation and robust mechanical ability as early as 12 weeks postoperatively. These outcomes demonstrated that employing the stratified approach and gene immobilization efficiently expedites silk-mediated ACL interface formation, expanding the therapeutic potential of the silk-based ligament graft for ACL reconstruction.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究丝素韧带移植物，与用户关注的增材制造生物医用金属植入物方向不相关。
llm.why_not_core: No additive manufacturing, LPBF, porous metal structures, stress shielding, or mechanical testing of metallic implants; instead focuses on silk scaffold and gene immobilization for ligament graft.

summary_zh.motivation: 增强丝素韧带移植物骨整合效果
summary_zh.method: 构建基因修饰的三相丝素支架并分层固定TGF-β3和BMP2
summary_zh.result: 兔模型中12周即可实现近似完全的骨整合
summary_zh.validation: 体外BMSC实验和兔ACL缺损模型体内验证

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the osseointegration of silk-based anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) grafts through a stratified scaffold and gene immobilization.
summary_en.method: A gene-immobilized triphasic silk scaffold was fabricated by dividing isotropic silk into three regions and immobilizing lentiviral vectors encoding TGF-β3 and BMP2 onto different regions.
summary_en.result: The gene-modified scaffold combined with BMSCs achieved nearly complete osseointegration with three-layered tissue formation and robust mechanical ability by 12 weeks postoperatively in a rabbit ACL-defect model.
summary_en.validation: In vitro BMSC proliferation and differentiation assays and in vivo rabbit ACL-defect model with histological and mechanical evaluation.
